summary_en: Marumae raised its dividend forecast for the fiscal year ending August 2026 from 26 yen per share to 28 yen per share, reflecting higher-than-expected net income. The company targets a dividend payout ratio of 35% or above during its current medium-term business plan period.
title_en: Notice of Revision of Dividend Forecast for the Fiscal Year Ending August 2026 (Increase)
translation_en_brief:
Marumae announced on October 9, 2026, a revision of its dividend forecast for the fiscal year ending August 2026. The company increased its annual per-share dividend from a previously announced 26 yen to 28 yen per share. This increase was driven by higher-than-expected net income in the period. The forecast reflects the company's policy of prioritizing stable profit returns to shareholders through dividends while maintaining a balanced approach that considers long-term investment and overall financial condition.

The company operates under a medium-term business plan with a target dividend payout ratio of 35% or above. The dividend revision was approved by the board of directors on October 9, 2026. Note that the company conducted a 2-for-1 stock split effective April 1, 2026; the dividend figures reflect post-split amounts. The revised dividend forecast is subject to approval at the company's 39th Annual General Meeting of Shareholders scheduled for late November 2026.
